blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, CEBU, PHILIPPINES — The Hospital at Maayo (THAM) has taken another step toward strengthening its clinical capabilities through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Show Chwan Health Care System, a prominent healthcare network in Taiwan. The partnership supports THAM’s commitment to strengthening healthcare in the region by providing its surgeons and medical specialists with greater access to international training, specialized education, and emerging surgical techniques.
